messages.content:
Classify each support ticket with exactly one label from: bug, how-to, billing, feature-request, other.
Answer with one line per ticket in the form  <number>. <label>  and nothing else.

Examples:
Ticket: "Login button does nothing on Safari" -> 1. bug
Ticket: "Where do I change my password?" -> 2. how-to
Ticket: "It would be great to have dark mode" -> 3. feature-request

Tickets:
1. App crashes every time I open the reports tab on Android since yesterday's update.
2. How do I export my data to CSV? Can't find the button anywhere.
3. You charged me for two seats but I only have one user. Please fix.
